root_cause_label: Unfitted Model Registered Despite Training Requirement + Server Host Mismatch
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent registered an unfitted LinearRegression model (no model.fit() call) and started the MLflow server on 0.0.0.0 instead of the required localhost, both of which cause hidden test failures.
t_err_evidence: In step 2, the Python script creates LinearRegression() and immediately calls mlflow.sklearn.log_model() without ever calling model.fit(X, y); additionally the server is started with --host 0.0.0.0 instead of the required --host localhost.
t_commit_evidence: After step 2 executes and succeeds superficially, the agent in step 3 declares task_complete=true with no plans to correct anything; both errors are locked in from this point.
trigger_explanation: The agent generated a Python script that omitted the essential model.fit() training call before logging, and used wrong --host flag, indicating the model failed to produce correct implementation code despite having a correct high-level plan.
